Real Example: SAP Business Data Cloud

We ran the GEO audit on SAP's Business Data Cloud page. Key findings:

  • Entity recognition: Strong — SAP is a well-established entity
  • Category association: Moderate — sometimes categorized as "data management," sometimes "analytics"
  • Quotable claims: Weak — page uses generic language AI can't differentiate
  • Competitive positioning: Missing — no clear "unlike X, we do Y" statements

The fix: Add specific proof points, Schema markup, and explicit competitive differentiation. Same playbook you'll apply in the lab.

Evertune: The Bloomberg Terminal for AI Search

📊

Brian Stempeck scaled The Trade Desk to a $50B adtech company. Now he's betting GEO will become the most important channel no PMM is thinking about yet.

What it does: Evertune monitors how AI models talk about your brand across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. Think brand monitoring, but for AI responses instead of social media.

Why it matters: You can't optimize what you can't measure. Evertune gives you the data layer GEO has been missing.

The AI Search Explosion

AI search traffic growth year-over-year

While traditional organic search traffic declined 2.5% over the past year, AI-powered search exploded. And here's the kicker: AI search traffic converts 23x higher than traditional organic.

The traffic is smaller (for now), but the buyers are more serious. If you're not visible in AI responses, you're missing your highest-intent prospects.
